pages.text: HEY MONGREL! I'LL GIVE YA 100 YEN IF YA EAT THIS CIGARETTE.

pages.text: IF ANOTHER DEVIL SHOWS UP, WE'LL CALL YOU.

pages.text: THAT PEOPLE NORMALLY EAT BREAD WITH JAM SPREAD ALL OVER IT.

pages.text: WELL, NORMALITY'S JUST A DREAM FOR US THOUGH.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I DOUBT I'LL PAY OFF THIS DEBT BEFORE I DIE.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: NOT LIKE I COULD BRING A GIRL BACK TO THIS SHITSHACK. DON'T HAVE THE CASH TO BE DATIN' EITHER.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IF I COULD GET ANY WISH GRANTED, I'D WANNA BE WITH A GIRL BEFORE I DIE...

pages.text: YOU DON'T SMELL LIKE A DEVIL OR A HUMAN.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: COULD HE BE TAKEN OVER BY A DEVIL?

pages.text: NO, YOU CAN TELL TAKE-OVERS BY LOOKING AT THEIR FACE.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: HEY, GO EASY, MAN. HE HOLDS A MEAN GRUDGE.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IT'S THE BLONDE HAIR AND GREEN EYES THAT DOES IT.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: JUST DON'T PUT ME IN THE POSITION OF HAVING TO KILL YOU.

pages.text: WH--? YOU BEEN WATCHING OLD MOVIES, SHORTER?

pages.text: HA, HA! THAT WAS SOME CORNY SHIT, HUH?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: GOES WITH THE BALD SPOTS, MAN!

pages.text: BUT, UH... YOU DO KNOW IT'S JUST SHAVED, RIGHT?

pages.text: YOU LOOK TIRED. HOW 'BOUT I GET SOME COFFEE?

pages.text: NAW, IT'S COOL. GONNA TAKE A LITTLE NAP INSTEAD.

pages.text: GUESS I'LL BE ON MY WAY THEN.

pages.text: I DID HEAR SOMETHIN'. I HEAR IT WAS ACTUALLY ARTHUR WHO GAVE 'EM THE WORD.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: SOONER OR LATER, I'M GOING TO HAVE TO SETTLE WITH HIM.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: YOU STACKIN' UP ENEMIES IN THE FAMILY, ASH.

pages.text: I'D APPRECIATE IT IF YOU COULD OPEN THE DOOR A BIT MORE GENTLY.

pages.text: I WANT YOU TO GET UP... AND I WANT YOU TO WALK AWAY.

pages.text: YOU'RE OUT OF HERE. FOR GOOD.

pages.text: AND LET ME EXPLAIN SOMETHING BEFORE YOU GO.

pages.text: WELL, I'VE GOT MY REASONS, AND I NEED TO BE HOME BY FIVE.

pages.text: WHOA, THAT'S IMPRESSIVE. HE DID THAT WITHOUT CURSED ENERGY, JUST NATURAL ABILITY!

pages.text: THE MAJORITY ARE THE RESULT OF NEGATIVE ENERGY THAT FLOWS OUT OF PEOPLE...

pages.text: PLACES WHERE CROWDS GATHER, LIKE SCHOOLS OR HOSPITALS...

pages.text: IT DOESN'T MATTER IF YOU BELIEVE ME OR NOT!

pages.text: PAIN, REGRET, HUMILIATION... THE MORE PEOPLE DWELL ON BAD MEMORIES...

pages.text: THE MORE THESE PLACES BECOME RECEPTIVE TO THOSE FEELINGS.

pages.text: ISN'T THAT A GOOD THING? HOW'S THAT DANGEROUS?

pages.text: THE MORE EVIL PLACED ON A CURSED OBJECT, THE MORE IT DEFLECTS OTHER CURSES.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: USING POISON TO FEND OFF POISON.

pages.text: AFTER MANY YEARS, THE SEAL WEAKENS AND THE TALISMAN ESSENTIALLY CHANGES FORM.

pages.text: THEN IT ATTRACTS CURSES AND FEEDS ON THEM.

pages.text: COMPARED TO OTHER CURSED OBJECTS, THE ONE PLACED AT YOUR SCHOOL IS EXTREMELY DANGEROUS AND IS CATEGORIZED AS SPECIAL GRADE.

pages.text: LIKE I SAID, I DON'T CARE.

pages.text: BUT YOU BETTER EXPLAIN THIS TO MY FRIENDS!
